owner_decision: Owner: 'Then do that, continue' - adopt the capital term (M1C) on the capital-specific evidence although the declared all-town rule was missed (all-town held-out MAE -1.7% vs 2% required). This is a post-hoc adoption by owner decision and is recorded as such.
model: M1C full-data fit from output/size_capital_term_20261115/results.json: ln area = 2.0946 + 0.1236 lnH + 1.2551 capital, held-out sigma 1.0197, area range 1-1783 ha as before.
capital_flag_on_the_map: capital = 1 for the 19 recorded provincial seats of the administrative hierarchy (atlases/earth_fit/data/release3/hierarchy/<climate>/hierarchy_links.csv, column province_seat; includes the imperial capital Aenaha), matched by name to marked release-3 sites (all 19 are marked campaign places); 0 for every other town.
build: scripts/build_settlement_release3.py rebuilt through a wrapper that adds the capital term to the mean (everything else unchanged: positions, draws and seeds, clipping, the people ledger, the strict lore ordering of marked places on final size).
downstream: Wide supply at the Earth shares (0.337 sliding, 0.140 flat), reviewers, publication as the default Settlements maps with notes naming the capital term and the owner decision; staffing of the control rule compared (if unchanged, reach/control maps stay as published).
